AUTHOR: Villon
TITLE: Automatic underwater fish species classification with limited data using few-shot learning
SPECIES: 20 common coral reef fish species (Acanthuridae, Chaetodontidae, Labridae, Lethrinidae, Monacanthidae, Pomacentridae, Zanclidae), e.g., Naso elegans, Chaetodon auriga, Pomacentrus sulfureus
DATA: Own GoPro Hero3+/4+ videos (175 videos, Mayotte): T0 69,169 thumbnails (130 videos), T1 6,320 (20 videos), T2 test 13,232 (25 videos); MiniImageNet for FSL meta-training
D2: Train T0 (130 videos) or T1 (20 videos); independent test T2 (25 videos)
D_EV: Methods: 'The three thumbnails datasets are fully independent, as they were extracted from videos recorded at different sites, with different conditions ... and on different days.'
R_EV: Methods: 'All the DL and FSL models were tested on the independent T2 dataset.' (T0/T1/T2 all from Mayotte GoPro videos, same study system)
C_EV: Pure classification of pre-cropped thumbnails; no score threshold or reject option reported: 'Accuracy is the % correct classification of models on T2 test dataset.'
E_EV: Table 2: 'Accuracy is the % correct classification of models on T2 test dataset.' (classification accuracy only)
ARCH: ResNet-100 (classic DL with augmentation) vs Reptile few-shot meta-learning (5-way, 1-30 shots); NLME asymptotic accuracy model
METR: Per-species and mean accuracy, SD, pairwise proportion tests, NLME asymptote
NOTE: V: only states datasets came from 'different conditions (weather, lighting, depth, time of the day, seascape)' with no values; not coded as V2/V3 reported -> V_ALL=NR (a verifier could treat lighting/depth mention as V3/V2 and give P). D: T0/T1/T2 from different videos, sites and days -> D1=사이트/서식지. R: T1 and T2 were 'two trips in the field of a week each' in Mayotte with same cameras; whether a separate trip counts as a different campaign is unclear -> lower-information R1=N per P2. C: classification-only, no threshold/reject -> NA. PRE: Reptile meta-trained on MiniImageNet; ResNet initialisation not stated. PLAT not stated in this paper (GoPro underwater videos). Text is the HAL author version.
